test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling a car for Rs. 1,20,000, David makes a profit of 20%. What will be the selling price of the car if he sells it at 30% profit?
solution:
**Given:**

By selling a car for Rs. 1,20,000, David makes a profit of 20%.

**Calculations:**

Let the cost of car be x

Selling price = cost price + 20% of cost price

By selling a car for Rs. 1,20,000, David makes a profit of 20%

⇒ 120% of x = 120000

⇒ x = 100000

Selling price (at 30% profit) = 100000 + 30% of 100000

⇒ 130000

**∴ The correct choice is option 2**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Let the selling price at 30% profit be x rupees,

At 20% profit value becomes 120%, Similarly at 30% it becomes 130%

So,

120% : 130% = 120000 : x

⇒ x = 130000 rupees

**Selling price at 30% profit will be Rs. 130000.**
